reviews.text: Honestly, the best doggy daycare I’ve used to this day! You can tell the team genuinely care about the dogs, and my pup comes home happy, tired, and clearly convinced they’ve had a better day than I have 😂. I love the flexible pick up hours and I have complete peace of mind knowing they’re in such good hands. Highly recommend! …

Extremely happy with your services and facility! As a first time pup owner worried about her staying home alone all day so young, this place was the perfect find! Easy, affordable and all staff are so kind and caring. The pictures and progress report are just the cherry on top. Thank you for taking care of my girl!

I have been bring my dog here since they opened and it has always been amazing! The staff is so friendly and helpful, always available to answer your questions. I love the daily updates that are sent about my dog and the photos that go along with it, helps me to know he is having a great time! Would highly recommend sending your dog here for daycare or boarding!

Our pup absolutely LOVES it at Dallas Dog Daycare and Boarding.  We take him just to let him play with other dogs and he actually pouts when he doesn't go.  When we turn on the street going there he goes nuts with excitement.  Their prices are more than fair, the staff is always friendly, the pictures they send after every stay are so much fun and they are super accommodating if you have a crazy schedule.  We are so happy we found them and so is our sweet boy!
They are great!!

Traveling through Dallas and felt bad for our dogs being stuck in the hotel all day while w explored and came across Dallas love field daycare!! Kind of nervous dropping them off and not knowing what to expect for how they would react. Paid a fee for after hours and staff was very communicative throughout the experience. When we went to pick them up they came out so excited and you could definitely tell they had fun. The staff explained to me how they did during their visit which was very heartwarming to hear since I was nervous at first. Prices were very reasonable and not overly expensive. I’d definitely recommend and I would come back again! 1000/10!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️

My furbabies absolutely love coming to Dallas Dog Care. Hunter and Ollie are always the happiest boys when they’re dropped off. I truly appreciate everyone who works there. Thank you for taking such great care of my sweet babies.

We absolutely love Dallas Dog Daycare! Hunter and Ollie are the happiest when they are here. For any Furparent looking to board or drop off their furbaby for daycare we absolutely recommend them. They are amazing!

We’ve been coming here for daycare for over a year now and I honestly can’t say enough good things:

- Knox gets SO excited every time we pull up
- Recommended this place to a friend who was underwhelmed with other spots and now she’s a regular
- LOVE the pawgress reports. I have an entire album on my phone dedicated to the photos
- Super convenient that they offer grooming + we’ve used it pretty regularly and they always do a great job
- The team here is truly amazing. So kind, caring, and clearly love what they do

The team here also do a great job creating a safe + well-managed environment:

- I really appreciate how on top of they are with vaccine records, they actively monitor and reach out with reminders when expiries are coming up
- There’s an indoor area for bad weather days, so the dogs still get plenty of playtime
- In the summer they do weekly pool days
- They also have misters set up to keep everyone cool on hot days
- They break up groups to match energy levels and offer solo play time with the staff

Have only used daycare so far, but if we ever needed boarding, this would absolutely be the first choice without hesitation.

Highly recommend 💛
Love this place!  They take such good care of my dog!  Friendly and caring staff, I love getting pawgress reports every day with pictures, I know my dog is happy here and well taken care of!

My dog has been going to Dallas Dog Daycare and Boarding at least once every week for 3-1/2 years, and he absolutely loves it there! I have also boarded him many times, and I have total confidence that he receives the best of care!

The staff is wonderful, friendly and caring. The initial recommendation for Dallas Dog Daycare came from my vet, I have since recommended them to many of my friends and acquaintances. So happy … and Bailey’s tail is wagging his approval as well!

I take my three dogs to Dallas Daycare and Dog Boarding all the time and they absolutely love the staff! The team there does a great job interacting and playing with all of the dogs.

They remember each of my dog’s names every time too, which really shows how much attention they get. Every time I pick up my boys they are always exhausted and I know that they’ve had a fun day.

I love how convenient the flexible pickup and drop offs are as well. I’ve had early morning flights and delayed flights late into the night and the team at DDD never cares. They work with me and make sure that we’re taken care of.

We also had a small issue once where one of my dogs got injured and DDD took care of the vet bill and gave us a credit to come back later on. I didn’t expect anything at all, but this meant so much. I really appreciate all that they do!

Our 3 dogs absolutely love going to Dallas Dog Day Care! Their staff is always friendly and accommodating, the location is spotless, and we love getting pictures of our pups throughout the day! One of our dogs is blind and the team does such a great job making sure that he is included in all the fun. Their prices are also extremely reasonable and their extended hours for pick up and drop off really help when you have a busy day!

I’ve been sending my dog here for 2 years for daycare a few days a week and occasionally boarding as well. She loves it! She’s always happy to arrive and when I pick her up it’s evident she’s had a good long day of playing. I also love seeing her pawgress report at the end of every day! She’s always been safe, they take great care of her, and the staff is so friendly. The flexible 24/7 pickup is also very helpful for travel, have even had to pick her up at 2 AM due to flight delays are they were very flexible. Couldn’t recommend this place enough and I’m so happy to have somewhere I trust!

Our Bernedoodle, Pilot, has been going to Dallas Dog Daycare for over a year and he’s loved every minute of it! We’re lucky to have a place that he loves and takes such good care of him for daycare or over an extended boarding session. We’re looking forward to many more years of Pilot going to his favorite place to play with his friends! The daily pawgress reports are also super fun to see what he got into that day and to get pics of our pup! Easily the best and most caring place to take your dog in the Dallas area with a very friendly staff! I highly recommend them!!

The best of the best! I was hesitant to take my dog to daycare but she was so loved and well taken care of here. Boarded her a few times with no issue. She was always excited to see her friends -both fur and human. We recently moved out of state and I’m struggling to find a new daycare that lives up to our experience here. Thank you so much to the wonderful staff! Abby misses you!

I absolutely love Dallas Dog Daycare. They do such a great job keeping me updated with my pup Mocha when I’m out of town. She’s a happy girl when she’s there and I don’t have anxiety leaving her with them. Thank you for everything you do DDD team ☺️🩷

Dallas Dog Daycare and Boarding has been the answer we were looking for! I have a very finicky Great Pyrenees, a rescue, that doesn't trust many people. 4 previous facilities did not work out, so I was hesitate at first to try them. A friend recommended them and I am so glad they did! My boy is always happy to visit and bummed to have to leave lol And the "pawgress reports" are the best :)

I took both of my dogs and it was a great experience. I received updates on how they adjusted to the other dogs, there were pictures taken of them throughout the day. The owner was there when we picked them up and gave us a thorough explanation of their service. I highly recommend them for Daycare and for boarding.
My dog loves it here. Having a golden, it’s hard to find people that know how to take care of him with the skin issues and allergies. They take care of the dogs really well.

This place is absolutely hands down the best in Dallas!
My fur baby loves to come!
Very professional and friendly staff, this is the only place in Dallas I would trust with my dog, she loves it here.
The best place to leave your dog so much peace of mind. 100% recommended
So grateful for this place. Our boys have a great time whenever they visit and I know they’re being taken great care of.
The best experience
They were wonderful with our dauchsund. Kind and they had same day availability when we needed it! Highly recommend.

I travel with my pup quite often and hate leaving him in my hotel room by himself. I just needed a few hours of daycare during the Labor Day holiday weekend and every business said they were at capacity due to the holiday. Dallas Dog Daycare & Boarding accepted my pup immediately and the onboarding process was super easy! It was his first time attending daycare and he had so much fun and I received pictures/updates throughout the day! They also bathed him before sending him home and he was soft and smelled amazing! I totally recommend this business especially if you travel with your pup! Thank you for taking care of my fur baby! I will be sending Capone to daycare next time I’m in Dallas!
Awesome place!!!  Highly recommend.
The best place for daycare in Dallas! Never seen my pup as happy as when she comes home from Dallas Dog!
Incredible staff - responsive, flexible and caring!
This is the only place I trust to take the best care of my girl! Staff is amazing and she has the best time. We always know she’s well taken care of when we are away. Would absolutely recommend!!
Excellent service
Very friendly and caring staff. We were pleased with the results and will use again!
So excited to take my doggo here i won a free bath, and have heard amazing things from friends!
Thank you so much for your review ❤️ :)

As a dedicated pet parent, I feel it’s important to share our experience, even though I don't want to harm anyone's business. I want to start by acknowledging that the owners were responsive to our concerns and did refund our stay, but I believe others should be informed about what we went through.

My partner and I decided to board our 8-pound Havanese while we took a trip, marking the first time we had ever left her with anyone outside of friends or family. This was already a nerve-wracking decision for us, but we felt we had no other choice.

We were assured that all dogs needed to be vaccinated and would be placed with others of similar size, which eased our concerns about our dog's safety and health. Unfortunately, this was not the experience we had.

At drop-off, no one asked for her vaccination records, and the process felt rushed, as if they were eager to take her back to her kennel and send us on our way. As first-time boarding parents, this was a bit unsettling, but we felt we had no other option at that point.

Throughout the week, we received “pawgress reports” with attached images. Early on, we noticed that she appeared to be foaming at the mouth, which was alarming since it was completely out of character for her. She is a regular walker and has never shown any such symptoms. Additionally, we observed that she was placed with dogs weighing at least 50 pounds. Unfortunately, we were in a location where we couldn’t make direct phone calls, so we communicated via email. When we expressed our concerns, we were told she was fine and that the foaming was due to their misters. However, I can distinguish between a wet dog and a dog truly foaming at the mouth. They also claimed she was with larger, older dogs that had calm temperaments. If you inform your clients that their dog will only be with those 30 pounds and under, it’s unacceptable to disregard that policy, regardless of the temperament of larger dogs. This caused me great concern during our trip.

When we finally picked her up, she seemed extremely exhausted, which we initially attributed to her playing with other dogs. However, that evening she began to show signs of illness, sneezing, coughing, lethargy, and a lack of appetite. Despite being fully vaccinated and having her canine flu vaccine, the lack of verification of her records raised concerns about whether she had been around unvaccinated dogs. Unfortunately, we had to take her to the vet the following Saturday as her condition worsened. She spent over eight hours there undergoing tests and receiving treatment, which resulted in an unexpected vet bill exceeding $800. When we reached out to the owners, they informed us that they had sent an employee to our vet to learn about her condition. This felt inappropriate; it's strange to send someone to our dog's vet without first discussing it with us. Our dog was eventually diagnosed with a severe upper respiratory infection, likely caused by kennel cough or a flu virus. She was prescribed two antibiotics for ten days and took some time to recover.

While the owners did refund her stay, we were still left with that hefty vet bill, ongoing concern for our pet, and considerable frustration.

This situation could have been avoided. They could have properly checked her vaccination records and those of the other dogs. If she was showing health concerns during her stay, like foaming at the mouth or coughing, they should have alerted us immediately. Additionally, they should have adhered to their policy of keeping her with dogs under 30 pounds.

I appreciate the owners’ quick responses, but I would advise caution when considering boarding your dog here.
Love the services provided. Definitely a 5 star experience.
Thank you!
Very clean, nice environment for my pup! Staff is always wonderful! Will continue to bring my pup here ☺️

Our boy Gus loves DDD!! We know he’s in the best of care when he’s there and the staff treats him like the king that he thinks he is. The second we say ‘daycare’ in our house, he goes bonkers knowing he has a day of playtime, cuddles, treats and fun ahead for him. He loves it so much that we’ve often had trouble getting him to leave.
Cutest doggy daycare in Dallas! Took great care of my fur babies! Highly recommend!! 🙌 …

Dallas Dog is hands-down the best in Dallas!
Our sweet dog Lucy absolutely loves it there—she's always excited to go. We've tried boarding her closer to home for several reasons. While those places were fine, it was clear Lucy just wasn’t as happy. So this last time, we made the extra drive to Dallas Dog, and it was absolutely worth it.

The owners and staff genuinely love dogs and have shown us how truly committed they are to exceptional care. Their passion and professionalism give us peace of mind. We love the thoughtful updates and adorable photos they send (my kids ask to see them every day we are traveling), but what we appreciate most is Lucy’s wagging tail and happy energy every time we arrive.

If you're nervous about boarding your dog, we truly can’t recommend Dallas Dog enough. It’s the only home away from home we have found that Lucy seems truly happy and excited to visit.

Probably the BEST daycare and boarding in DFW. I've had my dog try a few other places but nothing beats the care and love he gets at this place. Whiskey will miss his daycare friends!

"For Whiskey? Anything for Whiskey!"
We love Dallas Dog!
great service and quick
They had great staff and fantastic with the animals
Very good dog service and very good workers
This Place is the best. The prices are great and the workers are so Great I wouldn't have it any other way. Thank you so much for loving my pets and giving me the best service I've ever experienced
Everyone is friendly and my pups come home tired but happy.

Thank you for your 5-star review! We appreciate your feedback and are delighted to know you enjoy your experience with us here at Dallas Dog Daycare& Boarding. We strive to provide top-knotch experience for Tucker. We thank you again for choosing us!
Amazing!
super nice people, easy to work with and a very nice facility!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about this doggy daycare! My senior dog has been going here for years, and it’s been such a positive experience for him and for us. He struggles with anxiety, but the team here has worked wonders in making him feel special and comfortable. They treat him as if he were their own dog, and that really shows in how happy and relaxed he is when we drop him off.

The facilities are absolutely impeccable — clean, spacious, and full of areas where the dogs can play, relax, and have fun. I also love how they’re in constant communication, sending updates and photos throughout the day. It’s so comforting to know how much they care and that he’s in great hands.

What really stands out is how eager he is to arrive each day. He’s always excited to see his furry friends and the wonderful staff who give him so much love and attention. He truly looks forward to his time there, and I can’t recommend this daycare enough. If you’re looking for a place that treats your dog like family, this is it!
Such a friendly staff & they really care for your pets!
The facility is in a great spot, loved that I was able to drop off my fur baby before getting on my flight ! They sent me updates while I was away , 10/10 recommend! ❤️
I have extremely high standards when it comes to my “Dog-children”, and Dallas Dog Care has exceeded all of them. 10/10 recommend.
Our boys absolutely love going here! They do not look back once they go through the gate! We enjoy their Pawgress reports! They look so happy every time!

There are not enough words to say how amazing this place is!

1. Friendly and loving staff
2. Grooming availability
3. Large spaces to play. And they even have separate play grounds for the smaller and larger dogs
4. Daily pawgress reports so you can see just how much fun the doggos are doing
5. First time? They offer a free day dogcare
6. Boarding? No problem! They have kennel and suite options
7. They just opened their Arlington location and offer transport between both locations

My dog has been going here for close to a year and I am so grateful to have somewhere safe and fun! She has been boarded and attended daycare, and always runs in and is so happy to see the staff. It’s so nice to be able to leave town and not have to worry whether or not she is happy!

They also send out Pawgress Reports during her stay, which are absolutely adorable and great to see when traveling.

They just installed turf, which has been amazing, so my dog does not come home muddy.

Highly recommend this boarding facility! They are the best!

I always use this dog daycare to keep Lola when I go out of town.  They are always reliable and way more affordable than most of other daycares. I love the progress photos and memos they send me each day. My family actually loves seeing the progress photos as well so it doesn’t really feel like Lola’s really away from me. Highly recommend.
I follow their instagram page and this place is always packed with happy repeat customers. These dogs always look like they are having fun here.
I love the facility and so does my fur baby !! 10/10 recommend :)
Staff is great and my little Peaches loved her day of daycare.

I’ve been coming to Dallas dog for a few months now and I’ve never met a more terrific staff ! Stephanie sends me daily updates of my fur baby and she comes home happier than ever . I will continue to bring my fur baby here and can’t express enough how thoughtful and caring the staff is .
Dallas Dog Daycare & Boarding is the best! They take excellent care of your pups & always go the extra mile for them. Can’t say enough good things about them, highly recommend!!

We’ve been taking our dogs to DDDB for over a year now and have had great experiences. Our dogs are always excited to return for daycare and always leave begrudgingly, wanting to stay for more fun. We’ve tried several other places in the past, however, DDDB has been a blessing in our at times hectic lives and schedules.

Hi Ben,

We are so sorry we didnt live up to your expectations. As a small business, mediocre reviews can actually be quite devastating, and so we want to do everything we can to remedy your bad experience.

Could you provide context for your review so we can aim to fix it or improve? We looked for any owner named Ben and we have not had one since May. Was your experience then? If so, we are constantly improving and bettering ourselves, maybe give us another chance?

Otherwise, if you did come more recently, please let us know where we fell short, so we can improve for our other customers in the future. 

Thank you for your time and feedback, we really hope we can make this right.

This is the best dog daycare around! The owners are such a kind and caring couple. They hire the best staff and you can tell they care about their employees and the dogs they watch over. The past two years my corgi stayed at least 40 nights with them. I loved the pawgress reports they send out with photos to have insight into how my pup was doing while I was away. They were so patient with my stubborn corgi's love for being chased around the yard when it was time to go in for naps or the evening. No issues with administering her anxiety meds with dinner. They were always flexible with pick up and drop offs. I love that the dogs are kenneled separately, pack sleeping is not something that I am comfortable with. It also gave me peace of mind that the manager lives in an apartment on site so there is always someone close by in case of emergency. My dog was always eager to run into the building when we arrived so I know she loved being there and always came home tired and happy.  I recommend Dallas Dog Daycare to all my friends and family!

Our doodle has stayed here on a few different occasions for a week at a time and they have been great! Only issue we have every time is that while we provide a brush and ask that he is brushed daily, he always comes home with huge knots …

Parker loves going to this amazing place. Large outdoor areas for him to sniff around and play.  The staff is amazing, very caring and professional. Thank you so much for everything :) Love Love getting his Pawgress Report!

My benji boy had an amazing day. I only know because he ran straight home to eat dinner and then bed ! Thank you for making sure he had a comfortable environment that will provide him with that play time that he needs! He even got a haircut after his long day of play (and pool time!)
